name: Experimental D: height SVM + B disagreement guard + local affine XY
selectionTiming: Chosen retrospectively after comparing existing air cross-pass results and inspecting contact/row risks. Not a preregistered independent validation.
decisionRule: SVM height score >=0.2 contact, <=-0.2 air, otherwise abstain, subject to signal/support/XY gates.
Run the original B multiprototype classifier using only this model's training records and the original 0.75uT height margin.
If both accept but disagree, abstain.
If SVM abstains and B accepts, use B's height and XY.
Otherwise use SVM height and local affine XY.
position: Weighted local affine regression from the 24 nearest mixed primary/corrected training vectors; ridge 0.1, no rounding to known targets.
reason: Improved other-air-pass correct and abstain counts, but spatial held-out contact false-air increases materially. Preserve A/B/C and do not silently replace the iPad default.
scope: 0mm passes1+3 and 3mm passes1+2, phi0 theta90 alpha0, 50x30mm sweet spot; final model has no independent repeat left.
